<script lang="ts">
	import * as Sidebar from "$UI$/sidebar/index.js";
	import { cn, type WithElementRef } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import type { HTMLAttributes } from "svelte/elements";

	// The sub navigation of a settings area. Ported from the shadcn-svelte settings dialog block (sidebar-13): a
	// Sidebar.Provider with a non collapsible Sidebar.Root. The nested provider has its Cmd/Ctrl+B shortcut and its
	// cookie turned off, so it never fights the app sidebar that wraps the page.
	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		width = "13.75rem",
		children,
		...restProps
	}: WithElementRef<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>> & {
		/** Width of the nav, any CSS length. Twenty uses 220px. */
		width?: string;
	} = $props();
</script>

<Sidebar.Provider
	class="min-h-0 w-auto items-stretch"
	style="--sidebar-width: {width};"
	keyboardShortcut={false}
	persist={false}
>
	<Sidebar.Root
		bind:ref
		collapsible="none"
		data-slot="settings-nav"
		class={cn("hidden border-r md:flex", className)}
		{...restProps}
	>
		<Sidebar.Content>
			{@render children?.()}
		</Sidebar.Content>
	</Sidebar.Root>
</Sidebar.Provider>

<script lang="ts">
	import * as Item from "$UI$/item/index.js";
	import { cn, type WithElementRef } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
	import type { HTMLAttributes } from "svelte/elements";

	// A label and a description on the left, a control on the right, built from Item. The control gets the ids of the
	// title and the description, so a switch or a field has an accessible name and description.
	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		title,
		description,
		children,
		...restProps
	}: Omit<WithElementRef<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>, "children"> & {
		title: string;
		description?: string;
		/** The control. It receives { labelId, descriptionId } for aria-labelledby and aria-describedby. */
		children?: Snippet<[{ labelId: string; descriptionId: string | undefined }]>;
	} = $props();

	const id = $props.id();
	const labelId = $derived(`${id}-label`);
	const descriptionId = $derived(description ? `${id}-description` : undefined);
</script>

<Item.Root bind:ref data-slot="settings-row" size="sm" class={cn("px-0", className)} {...restProps}>
	<Item.Content>
		<Item.Title id={labelId}>{title}</Item.Title>
		{#if description}
			<Item.Description id={descriptionId}>{description}</Item.Description>
		{/if}
	</Item.Content>
	<Item.Actions>
		{@render children?.({ labelId, descriptionId })}
	</Item.Actions>
</Item.Root>

{title}

{#if description} {description} {/if}
{#if actions}
{@render actions()}
{/if}
{@render children?.()}
